accentColor.$description: The 'brand colour' for Studio, used wherever a non-neutral colour is required. Selections, focus outlines and checkboxes use the accent colour by default.

buttonDisabledBackgroundColor.$description: Background color of standard action buttons when disabled

buttonDisabledTextColor.$description: Text color of standard action buttons when disabled

checkboxCheckedBackgroundColor.$description: Background color of a checked checkbox

checkboxCheckedBorderColor.$description: Border color of a checked checkbox

checkboxIndeterminateBackgroundColor.$description: Background color of an indeterminate checkbox

checkboxIndeterminateBorderColor.$description: Border color of an indeterminate checkbox

checkboxUncheckedBorderColor.$description: Border color of an unchecked checkbox

chromeBackgroundColor.$description: Background colour for non-data areas of Studio. Headers, tool panels and menus use this colour by default.

foregroundColor.$description: Default colour for neutral UI elements.

headerBackgroundColor.$description: Background colour for header and header-like components.

headerTextColor.$description: Color of text in the header.

inputDisabledBackgroundColor.$description: Background color for disabled text inputs

inputDisabledTextColor.$description: Color of text within disabled text inputs

inputFocusTextColor.$description: Color of text within focussed text inputs

inputIconColor.$description: Color of search icon within search inputs

inputInvalidTextColor.$description: Color of text within invalid text inputs

inputPlaceholderTextColor.$description: Color of placeholder text in empty inputs

inputTextColor.$description: Color of text within text inputs

invalidColor.$description: The colour for inputs and UI controls in an invalid state.

menuSeparatorColor.$description: Color of dividers between menu sections.

panelTitleBarBackgroundColor.$description: Background color for panel/dialog title bars.

panelTitleBarIconColor.$description: Icon color for panel/dialog title bars.

panelTitleBarTextColor.$description: Text color for panel/dialog title bars.

subtleTextColor.$description: Color of text/UI elements that should stand out less.

tabBarBackgroundColor.$description: Background color of the container for tabs

tabHoverTextColor.$description: Color of text within tabs when hovered over

tabSelectedBorderColor.$description: Color of the border around selected tabs

tabSelectedTextColor.$description: Color of text within the selected tabs

tabSelectedUnderlineColor.$description: Color of line drawn under selected tabs

toggleButtonOffBackgroundColor.$description: Color of the toggle button background in its off state.

toggleButtonOnBackgroundColor.$description: Color of the toggle button background in its on state.

toggleButtonSwitchBackgroundColor.$description: Background colour of the toggle button switch.

spacing.$description: Base spacing unit (px). All layout spacing derives from multiples of this value.

borderRadius.$description: Base border radius (px) applied to panels, inputs, and interactive elements.

borderWidth.$description: Default border width (px) used across inputs, panels, and containers.

iconSize.$description: Default icon size (px) for UI icon elements.

headerHeight.$description: Height (px) of panel title bars and section headers.

inputBorderRadius.$description: Border radius (px) for text inputs and select fields.

inputVerticalPadding.$description: Top and bottom padding (px) inside input fields.

headerFontWeight.$description: Font weight for headings and panel titles.

boldFontWeight.$description: Font weight used for bold/emphasis text.

headerVerticalPaddingScale.$description: Scale multiplier applied to vertical padding in headers.

listItemHeightScale.$description: Scale multiplier for list item height. 1 = default density.

rowVerticalPaddingScale.$description: Scale multiplier for row vertical padding. Controls density of list/table rows.

transitionDuration.$description: Default CSS transition duration (ms) for interactive state changes.

headerFontFamily.$description: Font family used for headings. Inherits body font family by default.

monospaceFontFamily.$description: Monospace font stack for code, data values, and numeric content.

browserColorScheme.$description: Color scheme hint passed to the browser. Affects native UI elements like scrollbars and form controls.

gridAccentColor.$description: The brand colour for the grid.

gridAdvancedFilterBuilderColumnPillColor.$description: Color of the column pills in the Advanced Filter Builder

gridAdvancedFilterBuilderJoinPillColor.$description: Color of the join operator pills in the Advanced Filter Builder

gridAdvancedFilterBuilderOptionPillColor.$description: Color of the filter option pills in the Advanced Filter Builder

gridAdvancedFilterBuilderValuePillColor.$description: Color of the value pills in the Advanced Filter Builder

gridCellTextColor.$description: Colour of text in grid cells.

gridChromeBackgroundColor.$description: Background colour for non-data areas of the grid.

gridColumnDragIndicatorColor.$description: Colour of the indicator line when dragging to reorder columns.

gridColumnDropCellBackgroundColor.$description: Background colour of column pill in the column drop component.

gridColumnDropCellDragHandleColor.$description: Colour of drag grip icon in the column drop component.

gridColumnDropCellTextColor.$description: Text colour in the column drop component.

gridColumnHoverColor.$description: Background colour when hovering over columns.

gridColumnPanelApplyButtonBackgroundColo.$description: Background color of Columns Tool Panel apply button

gridDataBackgroundColor.$description: Background colour applied to grid rows.

gridDragHandleColor.$description: Colour of the drag handle on draggable rows and column markers.

gridFilterPanelApplyButtonBackgroundColo.$description: Background color of Filters Tool Panel apply button

gridFilterPanelCardSubtleColor.$description: Color of subtle text/UI elements in Filters Tool Panel

gridFilterPanelCardSubtleHoverColor.$description: Color of subtle text/UI elements in Filters Tool Panel when hovered

gridFindActiveMatchBackgroundColor.$description: Background colour of the active match used in Find.

gridFindActiveMatchColor.$description: Colour of the active match used in Find.

gridFindMatchBackgroundColor.$description: Background colour of matches used in Find.

gridFindMatchColor.$description: Colour of matches used in Find.

gridForegroundColor.$description: Default colour for neutral UI elements in the grid.

gridFullRowEditInvalidBackgroundColor.$description: Background colour for a row with invalid editor status.

gridHeaderBackgroundColor.$description: Background colour for header and header-like components.

gridHeaderCellHoverBackgroundColor.$description: Background colour of a header cell when hovered.

gridHeaderCellMovingBackgroundColor.$description: Background colour of a header cell when dragging to reposition it.

gridHeaderColumnResizeHandleColor.$description: Colour of the drag handle on resizable header columns.

gridHeaderTextColor.$description: Colour of text in the header.

gridIconButtonActiveBackgroundColor.$description: Background colour of active icon buttons.

gridIconButtonActiveIndicatorColor.$description: Colour of the marker dot on active icon buttons.

gridIconButtonBackgroundColor.$description: Default background colour for clickable icons.

gridIconButtonHoverBackgroundColor.$description: Background colour for clickable icons when hovered.

gridInvalidColor.$description: The colour for inputs and UI controls in an invalid state.

gridMenuSeparatorColor.$description: Colour of dividers between menu sections.

gridModalOverlayBackgroundColor.$description: Background colour of the loading overlay.

gridOddRowBackgroundColor.$description: Background colour for alternate rows (striped effect).

gridPanelTitleBarBackgroundColor.$description: Background color for the title bar of panels and dialogs.

gridPanelTitleBarIconColor.$description: Icon color for the title bar of panels and dialogs.

gridPanelTitleBarTextColor.$description: Text color for the title bar of panels and dialogs.

gridPinnedSourceRowBackgroundColor.$description: Background colour for source rows of pinned rows.

gridPinnedSourceRowTextColor.$description: Text colour for source rows of pinned rows.

gridRangeHeaderHighlightColor.$description: Background colour of the grid header when a cell of that header is in a range selection.

gridRangeSelectionBackgroundColor.$description: Background colour of selected cell ranges.

gridRangeSelectionBorderColor.$description: Colour used for borders around range selections.

gridRangeSelectionHighlightColor.$description: Background colour briefly applied when copying or pasting a range.

gridRowDragIndicatorColor.$description: Colour of the indicator line when dragging to reorder rows.

gridRowHoverColor.$description: Background colour when hovering over rows.

gridRowLoadingSkeletonEffectColor.$description: Colour of the skeleton loading effect.

gridRowNumbersSelectedColor.$description: Background colour of Row Numbers cells when all cells are selected.

gridSelectCellBackgroundColor.$description: Background colour for selected items in the multiple select widget.

gridSideButtonBackgroundColor.$description: Background color of sidebar tab buttons.

gridSideButtonBarBackgroundColor.$description: Background color of the row of sidebar tab buttons.

gridSideButtonHoverBackgroundColor.$description: Background color of sidebar tab buttons when hovered.

gridSideButtonHoverTextColor.$description: Text color of sidebar tab buttons when hovered.

gridSideButtonSelectedTextColor.$description: Text color of the selected sidebar tab button.

gridSideButtonSelectedUnderlineColor.$description: Color of the underline below the selected sidebar tab.

gridSideButtonTextColor.$description: Text color of sidebar tab buttons.

gridStatusBarLabelColor.$description: Text color for labels in the status bar.

gridStatusBarValueColor.$description: Text color for values in the status bar.

gridSubtleTextColor.$description: Colour of text/UI elements that should stand out less.

gridTextColor.$description: Default colour for all text in the grid.

gridToggleButtonOffBackgroundColor.$description: Colour of the toggle button in its off state.

gridToggleButtonOnBackgroundColor.$description: Colour of the toggle button in its on state.

gridValueChangeDeltaDownColor.$description: Colour applied to cell data when its value decreases.

gridValueChangeDeltaUpColor.$description: Colour applied to cell data when its value increases.

gridWrapperBackgroundColor.$description: Background color of the outermost container around the grid.

gridBrowserColorScheme.$description: Color scheme hint for the grid browser context. Mirrors shared/browserColorScheme unless overridden.

gridColumnResizeHandleWidth.$description: Width (px) of the column resize drag handle.

gridHeaderRowHeight.$description: Height (px) of the grid header row.

gridRowGroupIndentSize.$description: Horizontal indent (px) applied per row group level.

gridRowNumberWidth.$description: Width (px) of the row number column.

gridIconButtonWidth.$description: Width and height (px) of icon button elements in the grid UI.

gridSideBarPanelWidth.$description: Width (px) of the side bar panel when expanded.

gridSideButtonWidth.$description: Width (px) of side bar tab buttons.

gridStatusBarHeight.$description: Height (px) of the grid status bar.

gridToggleButtonWidth.$description: Width (px) of toggle button elements in the grid.

gridCellHorizontalPaddingScale.$description: Scale multiplier for horizontal cell padding. 1 = default density.

gridCellVerticalPaddingScale.$description: Scale multiplier for vertical cell padding. 1 = default density.

gridHeaderVerticalPaddingScale.$description: Scale multiplier for vertical header cell padding.

gridHeaderCellBackgroundTransitionDurati.$description: CSS transition duration (ms) for header cell background state changes (e.g. hover, move).

gridHeaderColumnBorder.$description: Whether vertical borders are rendered between header columns.

gridHeaderRowBorder.$description: Whether a bottom border is rendered below the header row.

gridRowBorder.$description: Whether horizontal borders are rendered between data rows.

gridColumnBorder.$description: Whether vertical borders are rendered between data columns.

gridSideBorder.$description: Whether a border is rendered between the grid and the side bar panel.

gridWrapperBorder.$description: Whether an outer border is rendered around the grid wrapper.

studioDragAndDropImageBackgroundColor.$description: Background color of the drag and drop image when dragging fields.

studioDragAndDropImageIconColor.$description: Icon color of the drag and drop image when dragging fields.

studioDragAndDropImageNotAllowedBackgrou.$description: Background color of drag and drop image when dragging is not allowed.

studioDragAndDropImageNotAllowedIconColo.$description: Icon color of drag and drop image when dragging is not allowed.

studioDragAndDropImageNotAllowedTextColo.$description: Text color of drag and drop image when dragging is not allowed.

studioDragAndDropImageTextColor.$description: Text color of the drag and drop image when dragging fields.

studioPanelContainerBackgroundColor.$description: Background color for the panel containers.

studioPanelDividerActiveColor.$description: Color of the resize divider when actively resizing.

studioPanelDividerColor.$description: Color of the resize divider for the panels.

studioPanelGroupTitleBarBackgroundColor.$description: Panel group title bar background color.

studioPanelTabHeaderSelectedBackgroundCo.$description: Panel selected tab header background color.

studioWidgetToolbarButtonHoverBackground.$description: Widget toolbar button hover background color.

buttonHorizontalPadding.$description: Left and right padding (px) inside buttons. Equivalent to spacing × 2.

buttonVerticalPadding.$description: Top and bottom padding (px) inside buttons.

buttonBorder.$description: Whether a visible border is rendered on buttons. true = solid border, false = no border.

checkboxSize.$description: Width and height (px) of the checkbox hit area and icon.

checkboxCheckedBorder.$description: Whether a border is rendered on the checkbox in checked state.

checkboxIndeterminateBorder.$description: Whether a border is rendered on the checkbox in indeterminate state.

checkboxUncheckedBorder.$description: Whether a border is rendered on the checkbox in unchecked state.

tabBarTopPadding.$description: Top padding (px) above the tab bar.

tabBottomPadding.$description: Bottom padding (px) below tab label content.

tabHorizontalPadding.$description: Left and right padding (px) inside each tab item.

tabTopPadding.$description: Top padding (px) above tab label content.

tabSelectedBorder.$description: Whether a visible border (underline) is rendered on the selected tab.

inputBorder.$description: Whether a border is rendered on input fields in default state.

inputFocusBorder.$description: Whether a border is rendered on input fields in focused state.

inputInvalidBorder.$description: Whether a border is rendered on input fields in invalid/error state.
